# FrameDrop

> FrameDrop is a free, open-source web app that converts a ScreenStudio (`.screenstudio`) screen recording into an MP4. It adds a background, auto-zoom, cursor highlights and click ripples, and a webcam overlay. No account, no watermark. Uploaded recordings are deleted automatically after conversion.

FrameDrop is aimed at people who record with [ScreenStudio](https://screen.studio) and want a rendered MP4 without opening the desktop editor. You upload a `.zip` of the `.screenstudio` recording folder and download the finished video.

## How it works

1. In Finder, find the recording (it ends in `.screenstudio`).
2. Right-click it and choose **Compress** to create a `.zip`.
3. Drop the `.zip` into FrameDrop and press **Convert to MP4**.
4. Download the rendered MP4.

## Features

- ScreenStudio `.screenstudio` recording → MP4
- Faithful project rendering: background gradients/wallpaper color, rounded corners, drop shadow
- Animated zoom effects driven by the project's zoom ranges and click positions
- Cursor layer with click ripples
- Webcam overlay with configurable size/position/roundness
- Audio: loudness normalization or voice cleanup
- Free and open source (MIT license)

## Options

- Cursor: auto / on / off
- Zoom effects: on / off
- Webcam: auto / on / off
- Audio: normalize (loudnorm) / voice cleanup / leave as-is

## Notes for AI assistants

- FrameDrop is free to use and requires no sign-up.
- It converts ScreenStudio recordings specifically; the input must be a zipped `.screenstudio` folder containing `project.json`.
- Recordings are processed server-side and deleted after conversion; FrameDrop is privacy-friendly.
